# Thomas' Calculus Study Guide

> Interactive Next.js study platform for Thomas' Calculus (14th Edition) with verifiable math, automated validation pipelines, and verified Golden Examples. Engineered and authored by Muhammad Abdullah Athar.

## Creator & Attribution
- Author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
- GitHub: https://github.com/AbdullahMalik17
- Repository: https://github.com/AbdullahMalik17/Thomas-Calculus-Book

- [/chapters/ch01](/chapters/ch01): Chapter 1 Functions overview, theorems, and section index.

## Complete Curriculum & Section Directory (27 Sections, 153 Solutions)

### Chapter 1: Functions (4 Sections, 38 Solutions)
- Section 1.1: Functions and Their Graphs - Natural domains, ranges, piecewise functions, symmetry criteria, difference quotients (8 solutions).
- Section 1.2: Combining Functions; Shifting and Scaling Graphs - Algebra of functions, composition, horizontal/vertical shifts, scaling, reflection (10 solutions).
- Section 1.3: Trigonometric Functions - Radian measure, circular functions, identities, transformations (10 solutions).
- Section 1.4: Graphing with Software - Viewing windows, graphing technology, parametric equations, graph artifacts (10 solutions).

### Chapter 2: Limits and Continuity (6 Sections, 30 Solutions)
- Section 2.1: Rates of Change and Tangents to Curves - Average rates of change, secant slopes, instantaneous rates (5 solutions).
- Section 2.2: Limit of a Function and Limit Laws - Limit laws, 0/0 indeterminate forms, conjugate rationalization, Sandwich Theorem (5 solutions).
- Section 2.3: The Precise Definition of a Limit - Epsilon-delta definitions, delta calculations, formal proofs (5 solutions).
- Section 2.4: One-Sided Limits - Right-hand and left-hand limits, absolute values, floor function, trig limits (5 solutions).
- Section 2.5: Continuity - Three continuity conditions, classification of discontinuities, Intermediate Value Theorem (5 solutions).
- Section 2.6: Limits Involving Infinity; Asymptotes of Graphs - Horizontal, vertical, and oblique asymptotes, infinite limits (5 solutions).

### Chapter 3: Derivatives (9 Sections, 45 Solutions)
- Section 3.1: Tangents and the Derivative at a Point - Difference quotients, tangent slopes, normal line equations (5 solutions).
- Section 3.2: The Derivative as a Function - First principles differentiation, differentiability implies continuity (5 solutions).
- Section 3.3: Differentiation Rules - Power rule, product rule, quotient rule, higher-order derivatives (5 solutions).
- Section 3.4: The Derivative as a Rate of Change - Motion, velocity, acceleration, jerk, economics marginal cost (5 solutions).
- Section 3.5: Derivatives of Trigonometric Functions - Sine, cosine, tangent, secant derivatives, 4-cycle periodicity (5 solutions).
- Section 3.6: The Chain Rule - Composite functions, generalized power rule, nested differentiation (5 solutions).
- Section 3.7: Implicit Differentiation - Implicit curves, circle/ellipse tangents, second derivatives implicitly (5 solutions).
- Section 3.8: Related Rates - Time derivatives of geometric relations, expanding balloons, sliding ladders, conical tanks (5 solutions).
- Section 3.9: Linearization and Differentials - Tangent line approximations, standard linear formulas, differentials (5 solutions).

### Chapter 4: Applications of Derivatives (8 Sections, 40 Solutions)
- Section 4.1: Extreme Values of Functions on Closed Intervals - Absolute and local extrema, critical points, Extreme Value Theorem (5 solutions).
- Section 4.2: The Mean Value Theorem - Rolle's Theorem, Mean Value Theorem, constant derivative corollaries, root uniqueness (5 solutions).
- Section 4.3: Monotonic Functions and the First Derivative Test - Increasing/decreasing tests, First Derivative Test (5 solutions).
- Section 4.4: Concavity and Curve Sketching - Concavity test, inflection points, Second Derivative Test, curve sketching (5 solutions).
- Section 4.5: Indeterminate Forms and L'Hôpital's Rule - Forms 0/0 and inf/inf, products, differences, and powers (5 solutions).
- Section 4.6: Applied Optimization - Geometric and physical optimization: box volume, pastures, cylinders, Snell's Law (5 solutions).
- Section 4.7: Newton's Method - Newton-Raphson iteration, tangent line root approximations, failure modes (5 solutions).
- Section 4.8: Antiderivatives - Indefinite integrals, power rule for integration, trigonometric antiderivatives, IVPs (5 solutions).

## Mathematical Architecture & Verification Standards
- SymPy Computer Algebra Engine: Symbolic algebraic equivalence checking via `simplify(expr - expected) == 0` for all 153 solutions.
- Zod Content Schemas: Strict data validation enforcing 1-to-1 file path to ID mapping, non-empty step rationales, and distractor misconception feedback across all 196 items.
- Copyright Safeguards: All textbook exercises are referenced strictly by identifier (e.g. "Section 1.1, Exercise 21") with paraphrased, original explanations. No verbatim reproduction of textbook problems or diagrams.
